clue.text: Spirit with cordial

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a witch's attendant spirit, often in animal form
second meaning: friendly and on close terms

explanation.walkthrough: Spirit with cordial reads like a drinks order, but neither word is a drink here: each is a separate meaning of the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: A witch's attendant demon is called her familiar, and a familiar manner is warm, friendly and intimate.

clue.text: See 26
Actor in manure working to make love

parts.note: marl is a lime-rich clay spread as fertiliser
a machine that is on is working
a make of car is its brand
love is zero in tennis scoring, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A crude story of a performer romancing in a muck heap.
explanation.walkthrough: Make and love look like the phrase make love; they are separate pieces, a noun meaning brand and the tennis zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Marlon Brando was the American film star of The Godfather and On the Waterfront.

clue.text: Fashion designer and graduate name actress

parts.note: Ralph Lauren, the American designer
Bachelor of Arts, a graduate's degree
to name someone is to call them something

explanation.surface: A list of celebrities: a couturier, a graduate and a named actress.
explanation.definitionFit: Lauren Bacall was the Hollywood star of To Have and Have Not, and wife of Humphrey Bogart.

clue.text: Bitter substance's name turns up in tree, almost dead

indicators.note: in places one group of letters inside another
almost means not quite all of it, so the last letter goes

parts.note: the acacia is a thorny tree

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up flips the word so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: to cite is to name or mention
D is the abbreviation for dead, as on genealogy charts

explanation.surface: A poisonous sap turns up in a tree that is nearly dead.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversed word goes inside the shortened tree after its first two letters, not at either end. D for dead is the usual family-tree abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Acetic acid is the sharp, sour compound that gives vinegar its taste and smell.

clue.text: See 2
Use train that's unreliable, seeking damages

indicators.note: something unreliable will not keep its order, so these letters get rearranged

parts.note: the fodder, eight letters

explanation.surface: A commuter fed up with late services is suing the railway for compensation.
explanation.walkthrough: Damages looks like a noun, the payout the commuter wants; it is the verb, wrecks.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruinate is an old word for bringing something to ruin, wrecking or destroying it.

clue.text: Elderly relative seizes on smell that's unlike her own

indicators.note: to seize something is to grab hold of it, so these letters go inside

parts.note: nan is a grandmother
taken as written
British slang: a hum is a bad smell

explanation.surface: Grandma catches a whiff of something that isn't her own body odour.
explanation.walkthrough: NAN holds ON plus HUM. Her own is the smell of grandma, a human, so something unlike her kind is not human.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandma is a human being, so a creature or thing quite different from her kind is not of humankind.

clue.text: Fully aware of golf tournament I'd spoken of

parts.note: the Open is golf's major championship

indicators.note: spoken of means the words are said out loud, so their sound counts, not spelling

parts.note: the contraction I'd is said exactly like eyed

explanation.surface: Someone well informed about a golf event they once mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with eyes wide open is alert and watchful, missing nothing that goes on around them.

clue.text: About to take detour perhaps?

parts.note: surface reading: someone on the point of turning off the road
setter's reading: the short Latin word for about leads the word, and what follows describes traffic sent another way

explanation.surface: A driver hesitating at a junction, on the verge of taking a diversion.
explanation.walkthrough: About seems to mean on the point of; it really supplies RE, and ROUTED completes traffic sent a different way.
explanation.definitionFit: Vehicles directed along a diversion because the usual road is closed have been sent by another path.

clue.text: Actress featuring in "The Italian Job", we hear

indicators.note: we hear points to the sound of the phrase spoken, not its spelling

parts.note: the 1969 film's heist uses three Mini cars

explanation.surface: A trivia question about the cast of a classic British heist film.
explanation.walkthrough: The Mini is a small British car, the star of The Italian Job's car chase; she was not actually in the film.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnie Driver is the English film star of Good Will Hunting, nominated for an Oscar.

clue.text: Razor blade passed round melon, one with supposed living matter

indicators.note: something passed round encircles what follows, so these letters wrap the next ones

parts.note: Bic is a brand of disposable razor
the Ogen is a small sweet melon variety
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A bizarre kitchen experiment wrapping a blade around a melon in search of life.
explanation.walkthrough: The razor brand splits after its second letter to take in the melon and the one. The Ogen melon, from an Israeli kibbutz, is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Biogenic describes substances produced by living organisms, so it has its origin in life.

clue.text: See 20
Foodie dwarf eating ham roast

indicators.note: ham acting is overdone and clumsy, so the following word is badly arranged
something eating takes food inside it, so these letters go within

parts.note: a gnome is a dwarf-like creature
the fodder, five letters

explanation.surface: A greedy little gnome tucking into a roast joint of ham.
explanation.walkthrough: Ham looks like the meat being eaten; it is the anagram signal, as in a ham actor.
explanation.definitionFit: A gastronome is a connoisseur of good eating, someone devoted to fine cooking and dining.

clue.text: Storm punctuated by storms with a domestic clear-out

indicators.note: a thing punctuated by something has it breaking in partway through, so other letters go inside

parts.note: a gale is a violent wind
taken as written
to storm is to rage

explanation.surface: A family row erupting during a big household tidy.
explanation.walkthrough: The plural storms and the single storm are different pieces; with a joins the plural, and the pair breaks into the single one after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Householders sell unwanted belongings from their garage or driveway, emptying the house of clutter.

clue.text: Bounder desperate for a job when playing around, we hear?

definitions.text: a job when playing around, we hear?
definitions.note: a cryptic description rather than a synonym

parts.note: a cad is a dishonourable man
dying for something is being desperate for it

explanation.surface: A womanising rogue looking for work while carrying on an affair.
explanation.walkthrough: Playing around sounds like an affair; heard as playing a round, it is golf, where the bag-carrier works.
explanation.definitionFit: Carrying a golfer's clubs over a round is a paid job for a caddie.

clue.text: Hapless character transported on the air

indicators.note: things transported are carried to new places, so these letters are moved around

parts.note: the fodder, eight letters

explanation.surface: An unlucky radio personality whisked off the airwaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A protagonist lacking heroic qualities, often bungling or unlucky, is the central figure in many novels.

clue.text: Likely loser and German gored badly

parts.note: und is German for and

indicators.note: done badly, the following word comes out in a jumbled order

parts.note: the fodder, five letters

explanation.surface: A bullfight where the outsider and a German were badly wounded.
explanation.definitionFit: The underdog is the competitor expected to be beaten, the outsider in a contest.

clue.text: Mutant canine tuna, say

indicators.note: a mutant has its make-up altered, so the following letters are rearranged

parts.note: the fodder, ten letters

explanation.surface: A sci-fi horror creature: a fish crossed with a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: Say is the definition, a verb, though it looks like for example tacked on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To annunciate is an old form of announce, to proclaim or state something aloud.

clue.text: See 3
Winner demanding seasoned actor

parts.note: a victor wins
seasoned means ripe with experience

explanation.surface: A champion insisting on an experienced performer for the role.
explanation.walkthrough: Demanding only joins the two pieces, as if the winner were demanding the seasoned one.
explanation.definitionFit: Victor Mature was the Hollywood leading man of Samson and Delilah and The Robe.

clue.text: See 24
See 10
Little piece of boy, a girl

parts.note: a son is a boy child
taken as written
a girl's name

explanation.surface: A small share of two children, a boy and a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: Little piece sounds like a fragment, but piece here is a musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: A sonatina is a short, simple sonata, so a small composition for an instrument.

clue.text: Disgraced shopaholic, one to associate closely with a stain on island

parts.note: Roman numeral one
to meld is to blend or merge
taken as written
to stain or blemish something is to mar it
Cos, or Kos, is a Greek island

explanation.surface: A tabloid line about a scandal-hit spender linked to a blot on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: Stain is a verb here, like blemish, not a noun for a mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The Philippine former first lady fell from power and became notorious for owning thousands of pairs of shoes.

clue.text: Topless sexy person embraced in amorous fashion

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase for an adjective: read as of an amorous kind

indicators.note: something embraced is held inside, so these letters sit within the others
with no top, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: erotic means sexy
a man is a person

explanation.surface: A racy scene of a nude figure being hugged lovingly.
explanation.walkthrough: EROTIC loses its E to give ROTIC, which then holds MAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Romantic describes feelings and gestures of love, such as candlelit dinners and flowers.

clue.text: Automatic character put together by acting musician

parts.note: George is British slang for an aircraft's automatic pilot
to form is to construct
taken as written

explanation.surface: A robot assembled with the help of a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: Pilots once nicknamed the autopilot George, so the automatic character is a name, not a robot.
explanation.definitionFit: George Formby was a British film star of the 1930s and 40s who sang comic songs with a ukulele.

clue.text: Claims girl has been grabbed by boy

indicators.note: something grabbed by another is held within its grip, so one name sits inside the other

parts.note: Des is a boy's name, short for Desmond
a girl's name

explanation.surface: A playground accusation: a girl says a boy grabbed her.
explanation.definitionFit: To claim something is to assert or state it openly, which is what one who declares does.
